title: Microsoft Paint CVE-2026-83844 (RCE) needs a Microsoft Store app update, not just Windows cumulative updates. Microsoft lists 11.2609.401.0
content_md:
Microsoft Paint CVE-2026-83844 (RCE) needs a Microsoft Store app update, not just Windows cumulative updates. Microsoft lists 11.2609.401.0 

via Mastodon https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-83844

CVE-2026-83844.evidence: MSRC lists CVE-2026-83844 as RCE in Microsoft Paint; no observed in-the-wild exploitation claimed.
